Role & responsibilities

Job Description: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Python + React + Azure + GenAI)

Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer / Lead Engineer
Experience: 8-12 Years
Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Gurgaon (Hybrid)

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer with expertise in Python, React, Microsoft Azure, and Generative AI to build next-generation intelligent applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in developing scalable cloud-native solutions, designing robust backend services, building modern user interfaces, and integrating GenAI capabilities using Azure OpenAI and LLM frameworks.

This role requires end-to-end ownership of application development, cloud architecture, AI-powered solution design, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative enterprise products.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Python, React, and Azure Cloud.
Build scalable REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Develop responsive and user-friendly front-end applications using React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Architect and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Design, build, and integrate Generative AI solutions leveraging LLMs and Azure OpenAI.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise knowledge systems.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, and workflow automation solutions.
Integrate vector databases and semantic search capabilities for AI applications.
Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Collaborate with product teams, architects, and stakeholders to define and deliver technical solutions.
Ensure security, scalability, performance optimization, and application reliability.
Mentor engineers and contribute to technical best practices and architecture decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Agentic AI, autonomous workflows, and multi-agent systems.
Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI orchestration frameworks.
Experience implementing enterprise copilots using Microsoft ecosystem technologies.
Knowledge of Azure Machine Learning and MLOps.
Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
